integrity: The period and no-drift assertions are analytic, not extrapolated from finite tests; a standalone reproducible Python 3 checker is supplied. Bibliographic originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Four equal nearest-neighbor oscillators; critical-period classification at alpha=pi/2 on sin(phi) !=0 and 0<abs(p)<1. Invariant J for arbitrary alpha only on sin(phi) !=0. No statement about larger rings or boundary trajectories. Bibliographic equivalence remains possible.
title: A lag-independent first integral and exact elliptic periods for a four-oscillator ring
